instruction: Buy me 3 extension cords on amazon of at least 3.9 product rating and 4.0 seller rating for my work address. They do not have to be identical.
notes: Single-app task. Since the three cords need not be identical, the model buys one qualifying extension cord with quantity 3 (search_products with query 'extension cord', min_product_rating 3.9, min_seller_rating 4.0; the agent must pick a result whose product_type is 'extension cord'). The cart is cleared before adding so the resulting order contains only extension cords (CartEntry changes are ignored by evaluation). show_addresses/show_payment_cards discover the Work address id and a payment card id (known-id); place_order requires the address flagged is-work-address. supervisor-complete-task carries the order record (product, quantity, address) as non-API parameters and is forced last via (task-completed). Ratings and quantity are discrete objects fixed by static init facts.
